key.name: dnd-until
key.summary: When Do Not Disturb turns off
key.description: Unix time in seconds at which Do Not Disturb is turned off automatically. 0 means that it stays on until turned off by hand.

key.name: durations
key.summary: Durations offered for Do Not Disturb
key.description: Durations in minutes that the date menu offers for turning on Do Not Disturb for a while.
